commands.description: List of shell command strings to execute. entr reads file paths from stdin. If a command is provided, it is executed with the files from stdin passed to the command's stdin or as arguments (depending on the command structure). To specify files, use a pipeline like 'find src/ | entr -s make'. entr does not have a separate 'stdin_files' directive; file lists must be provided to the command itself or via stdin.
